title: On finding exact solutions of linear programs in the oracle model
summary: We consider linear programming in the oracle model: $\max\{c^\top x \,:\, x\in P\}$, where the polyhedron $P=\{x\in\mathbb{R}^n\,:\, Ax\le b\}$ is given by a separation oracle. We present an algorithm that finds exact primal and dual solutions using $O(n^2\log(n/δ))$ oracle calls and $O(n^4\log(n/δ)+n^5\log\log(1/δ))$ arithmetic operations, where $δ$ is a geometric condition number associated with the system $(A,b)$.
